## Negative, boundary & edge cases

| ID | Category | Condition | Expected handling |
|----|----------|-----------|-------------------|
| TC-N-001 | Negative | `claim` with missing agent identity | named refusal, not a crash — `test_ready_claim_comment_verbs.py::test_missing_agent_is_a_named_refusal_not_a_crash` |
| TC-N-002 | Negative | `comment` with empty text | named refusal — `test_ready_claim_comment_verbs.py::test_empty_text_is_a_named_refusal` |
| TC-N-003 | Negative | `workspace.toml` present but names an unreducible (renamed) vault/console pair | named `RepoRootError`, not silent misresolution — `test_paths.py::test_a_layout_workspace_toml_cannot_reduce_to_one_root_raises` |
| TC-B-001 | Boundary | claim by the *same* identity that already holds it | idempotent no-op success, `claimed_at` refreshed — `test_tickets.py::TestClaim` (idempotent-reclaim case) |
| TC-X-001 | Edge | 8-way concurrent claim by different agents | exactly one succeeds, rest refused, no corruption — `test_ready_claim_comment_verbs.py::test_concurrent_claims_by_different_agents_exactly_one_succeeds` + `test_tickets.py::TestClaim` 8-thread case |
| TC-X-002 | Edge | 4-thread concurrent `atomic_update` increment | no lost updates — `test_tomlio.py::TestAtomicUpdate` 4-thread case |
| TC-X-003 | Edge | two concurrent MCP-HTTP sessions | notifications isolated, one closing doesn't disturb the other — `test_mcp_http.py::TestConcurrentSessionsIsolated` |
